articles.title: Artist Basanth Peringode takes Keralam’s murals to Rashtrapati Bhavan

articles.title: India’s blind women cricketers still wait for house sites and jobs a year after their World Cup win

articles.title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
articles.sum: The 43,500-tonne vessel built with 82% Indian content at Hindustan Shipyard can refuel and resupply several warships at sea at once; the keel of the fifth ship in the series was laid at the same ceremony
